notes.title: New game announcement: Castlebound!
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce our next big project

[b]Castlebound is a fast-paced action Roguelike with a twist![/b]

[previewyoutube=W2vNQrAlxTc;full][/previewyoutube]
Lead a band of up to 4 heroes in an unique action platforming style and fight hordes of evil monsters!

Game Features

[list]
[*] Fast-Paced Combat: Jump, dodge, and unleash devastating attacks to fend off relentless enemy hordes!
[*] Defend the Walking Castle: Protect your fortress as it moves through dangerous lands!
[*] Solo or Co-Op Action: Take on the challenge alone or team up with a friend for an epic multiplayer adventure!
[*] Multiple Playable Heroes: Fight alongside different warriors, each with unique abilities and playstyles that offer a fresh and dynamic experience!
[*] Roguelike Progression: Each run is unique, unlock new skills, heroes, and upgrades to enhance your chances of survival!
[*] A Unique Take on the Genre: Experience an innovative blend of castle defense and roguelike combat like never before!
[/list]

The battle for the kingdom begins now—will you rise to the challenge?

You can wishlist now

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3551820/Castlebound/

Steve
Ogre Pixel
2025

notes.title: New A Tiny Sticker Tale v1.1 update with New Content!
notes.notes:
[h1]New A Tiny Sticker Tale v1.1 major update with New Content![/h1]

We are super happy to share a new major update with a lot of new content for A Tiny Sticker Tale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949761/d4787219b3705fa4295950551d80fe1b025bd25f.png[/img]

Here is a quick summary of everything:
[list]
[*] [b]Flynn's customization[/b], allowing Flynn to customize their look with dresses, hats, accessories, etc
[*] [b]Bigger house to decorate[/b] (2 extra rooms added)
[*] [b]New NPC Merchant[/b], with him players will be able to purchase clothes and accessories, and special Halloween and Christmas items
[*] [b]Halloween special items[/b], available with the Merchant those special items will allow Flynn to decorate with Halloween furniture and there will also be a special sticker to change the environment of any place to Halloween
[*] [b]Christmas special items[/b], available with the Merchant those special items will allow Flynn to decorate with Christmas furniture and there will also be a special sticker to change the environment of any place to Christmas
[/list]
We hope you like this new update!

[b]If you are enjoying A Tiny Sticker Tale please consider leaving a review, that helps a lot![/b]

Steve
Ogre Pixel
[url=https://ogrepixel.com]www.ogrepixel.com[/url]

notes.title: Kickstarter campaign now live! + Public demo!
notes.notes:
Hello! We're excited to announce that today we're launching our [b]Kickstarter[/b] campaign for[b] A Tiny Sticker Tale![/b] Our game is a tiny and relaxing adventure where you can modify your environment with the power of stickers!

Our team is working hard to create a fun and captivating experience that combines the joy of gaming with the creativity of collecting and sticking stickers.

Now we need your support to make [b]A Tiny Sticker Tale[/b] a reality ❤️. With your contribution, we can bring this incredible game to more people and enhance the experience. Every little help counts, whether you choose a basic level or an elite one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43949761/e3ed69bd36358ea66d84ee63ace813b0d1265977.png[/img]

[b]We're offering excellent promotions and limited discounts! As a special token of gratitude, if you support us by pre-purchasing a copy of the game within the first 24 hours, you'll receive a free Steam copy of our multi-award-winning title, Lonesome Village.[/b]

Join us on this exciting sticky adventure. Visit our Kickstarter page and discover the amazing rewards we have for you:

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ogrepixel/a-tiny-sticker-tale][b]https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/ogrepixel/a-tiny-sticker-tale[/b][/url]
[b]
And last but not least! We have also launched a public demo today! So try it now and leave your feedback! :D[/b]

Thank you for your support and for helping us make [b]A Tiny Sticker Tale[/b] an incredible reality!
